mentions.name: monohunter
mentions.description: This tool finds single long-period mono-transits in public TESS light curves — single-transit events that periodic pipelines like SPOC/QLP, which fold on a period, structurally under-find. It is designed so many people can each search under-covered targets and combine their machine-readable finds, with runs covering thousands of stars at a time.
mentions.problem: Single long-period mono-transits are structurally under-found by periodic transit pipelines (SPOC/QLP) that fold light curves on a period.
mentions.audience: Many people who can each search under-covered targets and combine machine-readable finds.
